tasks.name: cam-19-gamehost
tasks.scopedGoal:
CAM-19: Extract transport-agnostic GameHost from party/cambio.ts.

Create src/game/host.ts with GameHost class that owns all game authority currently in CambioParty:
- Player join/leave/reconnect (resolveReconnectPlayerId, closeStaleConnections)
- dispatchMessage(playerId, message) wrapping handleMessage from engine.ts
- broadcastState() using buildPlayerView per peer
- Secret peek and flash event routing (secret_peek, peek_flash, swap_flash, snap_flash, penalty_flash, cambio_flash, reshuffle_flash, discard_draw_flash, deck_draw_flash)
- Snap window scheduling via setTimeout + expireSnapWindow (host clock authoritative); expose onSnapWindowAlarm() for Cloudflare adapter
- Bot move scheduling (collectActingBots, decideBotAction, BotKnowledge updates)
- Bot chat scheduling with optional groqApiKey param (undefined → template-only via generateBotChatMessage)
- migrateState helper

Define PeerConnection interface: { playerId, send(msg: ServerMessage), connected }.

Refactor party/cambio.ts to thin adapter:
- onConnect → host peer management + room creation
- onMessage → host.dispatchMessage
- onClose → host.removePeer / disconnect handling
- onAlarm → host.onSnapWindowAlarm() (Cloudflare-specific alarm stays in adapter)
- persist() → DO storage wrapper around host.getState()

GameHost must have ZERO imports from partyserver or Cloudflare types.
No behavior change for production online play.
acceptance: src/game/host.ts exists with transport-agnostic GameHost class
party/cambio.ts delegates game logic to GameHost (substantially smaller adapter)
